gloss: on the small side; somewhat less; light (portion)

definitions.gloss: on the small side; somewhat less; a smaller amount
definitions.explanation: Indicates a quantity that is slightly less than normal or standard. Often used when requesting or describing portions of food, drink, or other quantities.

examples.japanese: ごはん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{少|すく}なめでお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: A smaller portion of rice, please.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{少|すく}なめにした⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出費|しゅっぴ}→出費：09205_shuppi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{少|すく}なめ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抑|おさ}えたい→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to keep expenses on the lower side this month.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧ + the suffix め (tending toward, slightly). Indicates a quantity slightly less than normal.

FORMS:
⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧ (few, little) + め (suffix: -ish, somewhat). This pattern is productive:
- ⟦{多|おお}め→多め：28421_oome⟧: on the larger side (opposite)
- ⟦{大|おお}きめ→大きめ：21239_ookime⟧: slightly larger
- ⟦{小|ちい}さめ→小さめ：21795_chiisame⟧: slightly smaller
- ⟦{長|なが}め→長め：14550_nagame⟧: slightly longer
- ⟦{短|みじか}め→短め：20900_mijikame⟧: slightly shorter

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ごはん{少|すく}なめ: less rice (when ordering)
- ⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧{少|すく}なめ: less oil
- ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧{少|すく}なめ: less salt

USAGE:
Very common when ordering food at restaurants. Often seen on ramen shop order forms. Can also describe quantities in general: ⟦{出費|しゅっぴ}→出費：09205_shuppi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{少|すく}なめ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧ (keep expenses on the low side).
